excludedReview.decision: Justified HTML E2E boundary: machine-readable API has no interactive page.
Justified normal UI boundary: request/DOM forgery needed; legitimate selectable types covered E2E-029.
Justified concurrency guard branch cannot be induced by sequential normal browser action; visible duplicate behavior covered create/edit cases.
Verified no delete route/control exists; no destructive test invented.
Assets are not standalone UI actions; no external application link exists.

agentSkillReview.result: Instructions preserve canonical YAML, IDs, POM/evidence boundaries, serial browser execution and fail-closed completion; environmental corrections match observed failures.
limitations: No schema can prove sourceRefs semantic correspondence; preserve independent reconciliation review.
Console error absence is not a required expectation in current flash-expiry test; report confirmed existing defect explicitly.
